public_rationale: The records show financing dependence and continuing attempts to obtain capital. They do not establish either collapse or durable success. Because the prediction has no deadline, its failure cannot be inferred from the passage of time, and continued fundraising does not contradict it.
limitations: The failure criterion necessarily interprets a broad phrase.
One lab's risk disclosure cannot establish the outcome of the entire hyperscaler strategy.
Financing activity is context, not evidence of a settled outcome.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Hyperscalers' strategy of building capacity for and funding OpenAI and Anthropic to keep revenue growing will fail.

from_speaker: continue building capacity specifically for OpenAI and Anthropic
funding them in whatever way possible
to make sure that revenue growth never slows
our_interpretation: The preceding paragraph identifies the mission: hyperscalers supplying capacity and financial support to the two labs to sustain growth.
The ordinary reading predicts failure of that strategy, rather than merely a temporary slowdown, a financing setback or poor returns on one project.
No deadline is supplied. I do not import the nearby spending horizon into this sentence.
Durable self-financing would count against the prediction, but continued operations or another financing round alone would not settle it.
criteria.support_condition: Documented defaults, abandonment or restructuring demonstrate that the strategy has failed across a material part of the lab-dependent buildout because its demand and financing cannot sustain it.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The relevant buildout completes an economically meaningful operating cycle with independently verified customer-funded cash generation covering its costs and financing, demonstrating that the strategy achieved durable viability.
